end.text: Very good. All of these animals live underwater. More specifically, they live in the ocean.

atoms.b: This is a map of planet Earth. If you look at a picture of planet Earth taken from space, the most prominent colour you will see, is ((++blue red)). This is because most of Earth’s surface is covered by huge bodies of ((++water magma)), called oceans.

instruction.text: Scientists distinguish between 5 different oceans. Drag the names of the oceans to the correct numbers.
Which statement about the ocean is true?

b.sound: The ocean is very deep. Although there is no sunlight in some places, and the water pressure is extremely high, some creatures have adapted to this extreme habitat.
The ocean is quite shallow. This way sun rays can reach the bottom of the ocean and fish can see and navigate better.
Biologists estimate that there are more than one million different species living in the ocean, many of which have not yet been discovered.
There are not many animals living in the ocean.
The ocean covers 70% of the earth’s surface.
The ocean is the smallest type of habitat on earth.

instruction.text: Listen to the clues and then select the correct animal.

atoms.a: I am an invertebrate. I’m not a fast swimmer, but my stinging tentacles help me to defend myself from predators.
atoms.sound: I am an invertebraete. I’m not a fast swimmer, but my stinging tentacles help me to defend myself from predators.

hint.text: Invertebrates are animals that do not have a spine.
hint.sound: Invertebraetes are animals that do not have a spine.

atoms.a: I am a vertebrate with razor sharp teeth and a smooth body for swimming quickly and quietly.
atoms.sound: I am a vertebraete with razor sharp teeth and a smooth body for swimming quickly and quietly.

atoms.a: I am a mammal and the biggest living animal on Earth.
atoms.hint: Mammals are warm-blooded animals that secrete milk for their young.

atoms.a: I am a crustacean with 5 pairs of legs.
atoms.hint: Crustaceans are animals whose bodies are covered in a hard shell.

trainers.instruction: Humans are influencing life in the ocean more and more. What can influence the ocean negatively? Select the correct button.

correct.text: Plastic waste is a serious problem in the ocean. There is too much plastic which is threatening animals and plants.
An oil spill happens when, for example, a big ship has an accident and runs aground. Then, oil flows into the ocean, covers beaches and endangers animals.
The ocean is getting louder and louder. Huge ships and drilling platforms create a lot of noise. This disturbs animals in communicating with each other or from navigating safely through the ocean.
